page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some consonants are hard to read at this scan size, so the Hebrew forms are best readings and are marked [?] where doubtful. The left column ends "appropin-" and the right column begins "quabimus", a word broken over the column break. The page number 322 is printed at top left. The running head is the Hebrew letters nun and qof, repeated on both pages.
